subject: Renewal health check + Q1 usage spike
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@pegasus-analytics.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Lina Murphy <lina@pegasus-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal health check + Q1 usage spike

Hi Neha,

Quick note from our side ahead of the renewal: we saw an unexpected token spike in late January and again the first week of February tied to a recent feature rollout (chat summarization at higher temperature). Average token spend jumped ~65% week-on-week and we've observed a ~20ms tail-latency increase on embeddings endpoints during peak windows.

Attached is our Q1 usage export (pegasus_q1_usage.csv) and a short log snippet. Two asks:
- Can your team help unpack the latency uplift and confirm whether a Dedicated pilot would reduce cost/latency quickly?
- We need an updated term/commit sheet that accounts for the new baseline so procurement can evaluate.

We'd like to align on a mitigation + renewal path this month — procurement prefers a 60-day window to review new terms. My procurement lead is procurement@pegasus-analytics.com (cc'd).

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
CTO, Pegasus Analytics

Attachment: pegasus_q1_usage.csv (csv, 42 KB)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@pegasus-analytics.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal health check + Q1 usage spike

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the heads up and the export. I've pulled the usage file into a quick pass and flagged two things that explain most of the increase: higher average generation length from the summarization model and a burst of concurrent embedding requests from batch jobs you started on 2028-01-29.

Immediate proposed approach:
- Short-term: run a 4-week Dedicated pilot (1 GPU pool, routing set) to validate tail-latency improvements and measure token-cost delta.
- Medium-term: consider a 12-month commit with staged tranches (first six months lower commit + option to scale) to smooth unit economics.

I've attached our preliminary latency benchmark (latency_benchmarks.pdf) that shows typical tail improvements for similar customers when moving to a dedicated pool plus a short ROI sketch. Marcus and Jordan are looped for capacity and term construction.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm procurement contact and whether legal needs a redline window?
2) Would you be open to a call Thursday (2/16) with capacity engineers to review the benchmark?

I'll draft an updated term sheet (proposal v2) and share before the call.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: latency_benchmarks.pdf (pdf, 180 KB); prelim_roi_notes.txt (txt, 6 KB)

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Renewal health check + Q1 usage spike

Quick internal:
- Recommend the 4-week Dedicated pilot but with an explicit SLA trigger: if p95 latency drops >15% and unit cost delta <10% we include a 6-month commit at 8% discount (applies to embedding and generation routes used in pilot).
- Drafted numbers in proposed_term_sheet_pegasus_v2.docx (attached to this internal copy). Model: initial tranche = 40% of their current run-rate, ramp to 75% at month 7.
- Ask Marcus to validate GPU mix (A10 vs A100) — cost/latency tradeoffs matter for summarization workload.

Jordan
Director, Sales Ops

Attachment: proposed_term_sheet_pegasus_v2.docx (docx, 28 KB)

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@pegasus-analytics.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: Pegasus Procurement <procurement@pegasus-analytics.com>, Lina Murphy <lina@pegasus-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal health check + Q1 usage spike

Neha / Jordan — thanks for the fast follow. Procurement reviewed your outline and they're amenable to the 4-week Dedicated pilot as a pre-renewal experiment; procurement asked that the pilot start no later than 2028-03-05 to align with their budget cycle.

Two asks from our side before we sign the pilot SOW:
- Send a short term-sheet indicating the SLA trigger language you mentioned (p95 drop and cost delta thresholds).
- Send DocuSign-ready paperwork for the pilot and the 60-day review window for the full term. Procurement is procurement@pegasus-analytics.com (they're happy to get the DocuSign link).

If you can get the pilot SOW + DocuSign link over by Thursday 2/24 that will let us commit to the March 5 start. We can take the larger 12-month commit conversation into the 60-day review once we have pilot telemetry.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the call on Thursday.

—
Sanjay Rao
CTO, Pegasus Analytics

(Procurement contact: procurement@pegasus-analytics.com)
